# Caio Velasco {.hero-title}

**Data Scientist** with **6+ years of experience** spanning Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and Quantitative Research. My current interests lie at the intersection of **AI Development, AI Governance, Causal Inference, and Evidence-Based Public Policy**.

My work combines **statistical reasoning, machine learning, causal inference, and production data systems**, drawing on applied econometric research at **UCLA**, a **World Bank** research project, and machine-learning applications for one of Brazil's largest football clubs.

## Quantitative Methods & Applied Research {#selected-projects}

My background includes **statistics, econometrics, applied data science, and quantitative research**, with previous projects exploring **causal inference** and **program evaluation**. I remain interested in applying these foundations to **AI evaluation, governance, and public policy**.

### Causal Inference Projects

- [**Customer-Satisfaction Program**](https://github.com/caiocvelasco/project07-venv-causal-inference-difference-in-differences-program-evaluation.git): Examining the impact of a customer-satisfaction initiative with **Difference-in-Differences**.
- [**Recommendation System Impact**](https://github.com/caiocvelasco/project08-venv-causal-inference-propensity-score-difference-in-differences-program-evaluation.git): Assessing a recommendation system with **Propensity Score Matching and Difference-in-Differences**.
